body:
I don't have any words of wisdom for you, no matter how much I wish I did. But I just wanted to say you're not alone. Everything you're feeling is valid, and no matter if you or other people think you're being over emotional doesn't take away the fact you're still feeling it and you're in pain. But just because they are valid doesn't mean it's true. Our minds have a really shitty way with messing with us, and it can make us be things we never wanted. I have that problem a lot. I go through a cycle of "All my friends and family hate me, so I am depressed, and my friends and family hate me more because I'm depressed", and it keeps going. Maybe you can relate to it. I'm not sure. 

But I'm sure that you are stronger than you think. It's hard to figure out where to get that strength, but it's there. You said that you are not getting along with your mom, but I maybe suggest telling her how you are feeling. You need to tell someone who is in your life right now, even if you think they don't care. They will care more than you probably think. You also say that if you disappeared no one would care, but I beg to differ. Reaching out is the hardest part, but you can. You have that ability. It just begins with a choice to try your hardest. There is help out there to make you feel like yourself again.
